description: This file is a test script for Git's diff and merge functionalities involving binary and text files. It sets up various merge conflicts, verifies how Git handles binary files, text files, and attributes like diff and textconv, and compares the outputs to expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies the results.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified contents and message for testing.
